dedupe_keys.name: realtime weather readings across singapore nea apis

description: The Realtime Weather Readings across Singapore collection of the National Environment Agency on the national open data portal provides APIs for readings of air temperature, relative humidity, rainfall and wind conditions at up to one-minute intervals, at weather station level. The collection groups five related datasets, such as air temperature across Singapore, with coverage from May 2016 to September 2026, and each dataset can be queried through its API or downloaded from the portal. Use is free under the Singapore Open Data Licence linked from the portal. Caveats: the readings are station-level observations, not gridded fields, station density varies, and historical coverage starts in 2016. Coverage is Singapore. It supports hazard exposure and operations analysis of flash floods, heat and wind for drainage, roads, rail and power networks, and calibration of urban flood and heat models with observed rainfall and temperature; related records are the Singapore V3 climate projections and the SiReNT GNSS network, which share the same national context.
